reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism (uniform multi-component passivation layer driven by high configurational entropy) with a clear baseline (conventional alloy), controlled intervention (wear–corrosion test in 3.5% NaCl), and decisive falsification rule, directly addressing the research question.
